tags.name: a-scrollbar
tags.description:
(ZH) 面向 Pro 布局与高密度导航区域的双轴自定义滚动容器。

(EN) A custom dual-axis scrollbar container for Pro layouts and dense navigation areas.

attributes.name: visibility
attributes.description:
Default: 'auto'

Shared visibility strategy for both axes

attributes.name: visibility-x
attributes.description:
Default: -

Visibility strategy for horizontal scrollbar

attributes.name: visibility-y
attributes.description:
Default: -

Visibility strategy for vertical scrollbar

attributes.name: hide-delay
attributes.description:
Default: 1200

Delay in milliseconds before auto-mode overlays hide after the pointer leaves the content area

attributes.name: motion
attributes.description:
Default: 'fade'

Track visibility motion. fade fades in and out; slide slides in from the right and out to the right.

attributes.name: native
attributes.description:
Default: false

Use native browser scrollbars and disable overlay thumbs

attributes.name: classes
attributes.description:
Default: -

Customize class for each semantic structure inside the component. Supports object or function.

attributes.name: styles
attributes.description:
Default: -

Customize inline style for each semantic structure inside the component. Supports object or function.
